title: Learning system, learning server apparatus, processing apparatus, learning method, and program

pse.problem: Long search time for Neural Architecture Search (NAS) in federated learning
pse.solution_function: The system performs federated learning using an optimal neural network selected by a score-based search method. It cooperatively uses a first federated learning unit in the learning server and second federated learning units in n processing apparatuses for federated NAS.
pse.solution_structure: Each processing apparatus includes a second federated learning unit, a local data storage, and a score calculation unit. The learning server has a first federated learning unit and an aggregation unit.
pse.solution_implementation: The system performs iterative rounds of local training on each processing apparatus, score calculation by the score calculation unit, and neural network selection and global update by the aggregation unit in the learning server. The search is guided by a score that indicates the quality of a neural network.
pse.effect: Significant reduction in NAS search time, enabling practical machine learning
